evidence: The first mechanism will produce SiO 2 film with a 1 : 2 Si : O stoichiometry if no hydroxyl groups are lost by dehydroxylation. The second mechanism can also yield a 1 : 2 Si : O stoichiometry. A SiO 2 film is grown if every O-Si(OH) 3 species undergoes dehydroxylation with adjacent O-Si(OH) 3 species and becomes a O3SiOH species as shown in Fig. 15.
